meta.source: Figma file PriceTag - design (ll5qfLxbou5CwlnIE9xfxa), Page 1; dark theme and web tokens from the pricetag landing page

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The pricetag blue. Converted-price bubble, primary buttons, lock tile, the logo. White text on it.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand.

tokens.name: brand-text
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and outlines on surface or surface-page. Lighter in dark so it stays readable.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Popup body, original-price bubble, cards. Figma: white.

tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Website page background behind surface cards (landing page).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Popup bottom bar fill, divider under the input row, card borders.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text and icons on surface. Figma uses pure black at light weights.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface or surface-page: notes, captions (landing page).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Check (confirm) icon only. 2.0:1 on white: fails 3:1 for icons, kept from the source; pair with the button's shape, never colour alone.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: No / cancel icon only. 3.8:1 on white, passes for icons, not for small text.

families.sans: Pretendard, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif

groups.name: Extension
groups.note: From the Figma file. Light weights, line height auto (about 1.2), no tracking.

styles.name: bubble-price
styles.usage: The in-page price bubble that appears over a selected price.

styles.name: input-value
styles.usage: Amount typed in the popup converter.

styles.name: chat-price
styles.usage: Price pills in the popup conversation and history.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tooltip action labels under bubble buttons.

spacing.note: Measured in the popup: 16 margins, 8 between bubbles, 32 bubble and bar height.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked price bubbles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Popup inner margin, bubble horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Bubble height, bottom bar height.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Lock tile size; large section spacing.

radius.note: A pricetag bubble is a pill with exactly one corner cut square: the tail points at the price it belongs to.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small controls, the currency-symbol box.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Popup window, input field, cards.

tokens.name: radius-bubble-soft
tokens.usage: The softer corner beside the tail on the in-page bubble (20/32/32/0).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Bubble corners, pill buttons.

tokens.name: radius-tail
tokens.usage: The one square corner of every bubble and of the logo.

shadow.note: One blur, one offset; only the strength and tint change.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Bubbles, round action buttons, the popup.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered or active bubble.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured bubbles and buttons.
